The British Army Colonel was a officer working with British intelligence. He appeared in the 1963 James Bond film, From Russia With Love. The actor who portrayed him remains unknown.

page.overview:
Who is British Army Colonel?

The British Army Colonel was a officer working with British intelligence. He appeared in the 1963 James Bond film, From Russia With Love. The actor who portrayed him remains unknown.

This Army Colonel sits in M's office and listens to the tape with Tatiana Romanova describing the 'Lector' to Bond.
